name: hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c_q648-mc3c_q648-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-MC3c = MC3b + POST_REG=1: register stage on the post-metadata SRAM read data. Every MC3 placement-TT macro->reg miss at 833 ps (-113 ps p540 bank_n_word_local D / -148 ps q648 head_local D; 400 worst paths each) starts at METADATA[*].u_post rd_out (302 ps clk->q) through push_read -> enqueue_aq -> AQ wr_v -> bank_n/look_row/head_local. Now the post entry (bank/col/row/read flag + 8 regional bank/row copies) lands in kept stage flops and enters the AQ one edge later (wr_v = 9 kept copies); the read-reservation check covers every entry (post decision and u_post read address independent of the SRAM output). +1 edge request->column latency (static, priced). ACT_HEAD=1: ACT candidates start at the head entry's bank (the fixed bank-0-first order starved a closed high-index head bank: face_txn stalled at 7909/12944 beats); face_txn edges_safe 113181 (MC3b 166921).
